contexts: three small hospitals and one regional ambulance service
sparsely populated area with long transport times
reading: Compliance and timing can be measured now from ambulance records (claim c1), and timing is part of the standard because benefit falls with delay (claim c2). Whether early treatment changes outcomes here needs hospital data, and linkage misses the patients who matter most unless an agreement covers all sites (claim c3). Safety in older patients is uncertain (claim c4). The design therefore depends on a fact the investigator does not control: whether the data-sharing agreement is renewed.
